name: FIGat7th
summary: FIGat7th is Downtown Los Angeles's premier open-air shopping and entertainment destination, offering a curated mix of fashion retail, diverse dining, fitness facilities, and cultural programming. Located in the heart of DTLA's financial district, this urban lifestyle center serves as a vibrant community hub with regular events, a Thursday farmer's market, and a dynamic arts program.
demographics: FIGat7th attracts a diverse urban demographic reflective of Downtown Los Angeles, including young professionals aged 25-45 with middle to upper-middle incomes who work in the surrounding financial and business districts. The center draws both local residents from nearby downtown lofts and condominiums, as well as tourists and convention attendees visiting LA's urban core. Visitors tend to be culturally diverse, tech-savvy urbanites who value convenience, unique dining experiences, and entertainment options integrated with their shopping. The trade area benefits from high foot traffic from office workers during weekdays and entertainment seekers on evenings and weekends.
description: FIGat7th stands as Downtown Los Angeles's premier open-air shopping and entertainment destination, strategically located at 735 South Figueroa Street in the heart of the city's bustling financial district. This dynamic urban center seamlessly blends fashion retail, diverse dining options, fitness facilities, and a world-class arts and events program, creating what they call the "intersection of life x style." The center's open-air design provides a refreshing shopping experience in the urban landscape, featuring both big-box retailers and smaller boutique shops that cater to the diverse tastes of downtown's professional and residential communities. FIGat7th has become a cultural hub for DTLA, hosting regular events and programming including a popular Thursday farmer's market, arts exhibitions, and community gatherings that bring vibrancy to the downtown core. With its convenient location, comprehensive mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options, and commitment to creating an engaging urban experience, FIGat7th serves as a one-stop destination for both downtown workers and visitors exploring Los Angeles's revitalized urban center.
